decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 21 Oct 2028.

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 21 Oct 2025 [LBI ref: P2025/2324/FUL.    Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description:
S73 application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary the wording of condition 4(HOURS OF OPERATION (COMPLIANCE) of planning permission ref:  P2025/2324/FUL installation of an On-Demand Grocery (ODG) hatch to south elevation , dated 21 Oct 2025, for the following amendments:
 a)    change hours of operation of 'ODG' hatch from  07:30-22:00 Monday to Friday; 07:30-21:00 Saturday and 12:00-18:00 Sunday to  07:00- 22:30 Monday to Friday; 07:30-22:30 Saturdays and 10:00 to  18:00 Sunday.
